svg.title: How each job sees the garage: working_state
svg.desc: Every Expand<Type>Job copies ctx->initial_state and replays all events planned so far, so a later job sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it.
svg.metadata: ["Job 0 (REPARK_TRAY) has already been planned: it added event 0, which moves T15 from P15 to P23. The request's snapshot ctx->initial_state still shows T15 at P15. Now ExpandRetrieveJob starts job 1.", "(1) ExpandRetrieveJob copies ctx->initial_state into a local working_state. At this point the copy is identical: T15 is still at P15. The dashed arrow previews what replaying event 0 will do.", "(2) ctx->event_dag.ApplyEventsTo(state) replays every event planned so far (a failure fails the job). Event 0 moves T15 discretely to P23, so working_state now shows the garage as job 0 will leave it.", "(3) The job reads the payload on T17 from working_state, not from the request. Any choice it makes (free spots, blockers) already accounts for T15 sitting at P23.", "Job 1 adds its own events: first a TrayMove that brings T17 from P17 to bay B21.", "Then a BayTransition B21 -> PROCESS_RETRIEVE, ordered after the tray move. The next job will replay all three events. ApplyTo() is discrete: no paths, AGVs or timing yet."]
